Definition: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
BiblicalUsage: The word names a work or deed, what hands make and what men do, and it is one of the Bible's biggest words. God blessed the works of men's hands and warned that their hands would make idols, the heavens declare the glory of God and the firmament shows His handywork, and the Preacher says God has made everything beautiful in its time, though no man can find out the work God makes from beginning to end.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every work is weighed by the hands that made it, and the works of God are beautiful while the works of men turn to idols. I hold that our work is holy when it is done before God, because He blesses the work of our hands and the heavens themselves declare the work of His.
